name: Arabian Contracting Services Company
summary: Arabian Contracting Services Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in printing business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Arab Republic of Egypt, and the United Arab Emirates. It is involved in renting road advertising billboards, media advertisements and fixed art billboards, printing, and setup and construction. The company also offers general construction of residential buildings, roads, streets, sidewalks, road-related works, bridges, railway lines, pouring bases and foundations, and tunnels.
